name: Factory defaults
description: Values from the CDI-EM60 manual, Chapter 5 (cross-checked with Chapter 6). "machine-type" means the factory value depends on the drive model and is not printed in the manual.

name: Frequency-control spindle controller (original)
status: in service; unverified (factory defaults + PwnCNC pre-programming sheet 2/1/25 + Mike's setup notes)
description: Original spindle controller. The user sets spindle speed by dialing in VFD frequency with the VFD panel's built-in potentiometer (enabled by DI4 tied to COM). Wired through the converter box on the GX16-8. KiCad page: Original Spindle Controller.

name: RPM-control spindle controller
status: proposed; pending confirmation by Steve Pollack (copied from freq_control plus VF1/FM1 scaling for 3.3 V DAC/ADC)
description: New spindle controller designed by Steve Pollack. The user sets the desired spindle RPM directly; it also keeps a running spindle-time total for billing and signals spindle activity to the FOB controller. Connects directly to the GX16-8 with DI4-COM switch SW3 open.
